records.text: Dennis Prager fell and was seriously injured after publishing a hostile article about Candace Owens.

appearances.snippet: Dennis Prager, who had just written this open article about me, and it was not done in a very nice way, had actually fallen and was very seriously injured.

verification.notes: PragerU dates Prager’s critical letter to Owens to September 4, 2024, and confirms that he suffered a serious injury in a fall later in 2024. The sources support the temporal sequence; they do not imply that the letter caused the fall.
